title: Terms & Conditions
subtitle: Guidelines and fair usage policies governing your access to AI Tutor services, study sessions, and interactive content.

sections.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
content: By creating an account, engaging in AI tutoring sessions, or browsing the platform, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms & Conditions.
These terms apply to all learners, educators, and visitors utilizing our web platform or API endpoints.

sections.title: 2. Educational Use & AI Disclaimer
content: AI Tutor is an adaptive educational companion designed to assist your comprehension, practice, and study efforts.
While our AI models strive for pedagogical rigor, outputs should be used for learning and study assistance rather than definitive professional, legal, or medical advice.
Users are encouraged to verify critical factual information and use the platform to deepen their own problem-solving skills.

sections.title: 3. Fair Use & Academic Integrity
content: AI Tutor promotes active learning and authentic student comprehension.
Users must not use the platform to commit academic fraud, violate institution honor codes, or submit automated work as their own original creation where forbidden.
We reserve the right to restrict accounts that abuse automated query limits or engage in prompt injection.

sections.title: 4. Account Security & Responsibilities
content: You are responsible for safeguarding your authentication credentials and for all activities that occur under your account.
You agree to notify us immediately if you suspect any unauthorized access to your account.

sections.title: 5. Service Availability & Modifications
content: We strive to maintain continuous platform availability, though service may occasionally be interrupted for scheduled maintenance or upgrades.
We continuously update and refine our tutoring models and platform features to optimize the learning experience.

sections.title: 6. Governing Law & Dispute Resolution
content: These Terms & Conditions are governed by applicable internet regulations and international intellectual property standards.
Any disputes shall be resolved primarily through good-faith mutual mediation.
